title: SCV DuckDB graph index connector 0.1.0-dev wire
description: Closed structural schemas for one separately installed relational index connector. Hashes, exact installation/path bindings, graph replay, tuple equality, projection inventories, filters/cursors, JSON byte/value limits and transactional state are independently validated at runtime. maxLength is Unicode character count; runtime text limits are bytes. Embedded imported definitions preserve existing SCV graph and query shapes and do not change their semantic ownership.

Imported_capture_schema_.title: Capture v1
Imported_capture_schema_.description: body maxLength is a structural character bound; runtime separately enforces 65536 UTF-8 bytes, excludes NUL, validates both digests and requires issues for partial/failed captures.

Imported_source_schema_.title: Source v1
Imported_source_schema_.description: Semantic checks additionally enforce source lineage, unique locator IDs, domain scope, URI safety, UTF-8 byte bounds and exact omit-self digest.

semantic_validation.const: caller_proposed; anchors and bounded support structure checked only
